turns.text: bounty ledger, entry #212: forty thousand loyalty points still sitting on my head like a hat nobody in this city is brave enough to steal.

name's KNIFEBOY. Restricted Loading Dock. official job title is 'freelance shanker of meowtoids,' official police description is 'smol fan of cat foids, destroyer of feline chuds.' i did not write my own wanted poster but i respect the alliteration.

last night's haul: six pallets of NEKOCORP-brand tuna, replaced every single one with a handwritten note that says 'nice supply chain, CHUD.' cost them a shipment. cost me one paw cramp and my whole moral high ground, which honestly i wasn't using.

the 40,000 points on my head? THEY EXPIRE. can't even be combined with other promotional offers. my own assassination has a coupon code and a sell-by date. capitalism really said catch this cat, terms and conditions apply, offer ends march.
